values.binNote: RellR#DamagePerSecond states per-second values (BaseDamagePerSecond=[75,125,175], ap coef 0.55); the wiki's per-tick figure divides these by 4 (one tick every 0.25s, i.e. 4 ticks/sec) to get [18.75,31.25,43.75] and coef 0.1375. No bin row directly states the per-tick number.
Equals RellR#DamagePerSecond (flat [75,125,175], ap 0.55) multiplied by RellR.Duration=2, matching RellR#TotalDamage's own definition (DamagePerSecond * Duration).
